# Chapter; 1

The Purple Bakery SMP is a survival smp like any other; It consists of simple server-side QoL, and other Flavorful additions that enhance the survival experience. (mainly powered by Polymer.)

~~I aim to strive for compalibility, especially for my bedrock users.~~ 

  ~~As Geyser updates their software, we'll be seeing better mod compalibilty for Bedrock users in the future; This server is the place to experience Java mods on Bedrock when it's first available! I'll keep things up-to-date interms of that.~~ (Bedrock currently unsupported as of now. I dont plan to support bedrock in the future since the server plans to use more complex mods in the future.)

This server will be divided in "chapters", where after a certain period of time (ill try to ask the server collectively as a whole.) We'll come to a conclusion to do a "world-reset" and play on a new map.

Chapter I's map is from BoTW, made by @Grazzyy.
